sourceTargetRows.sourceEnglish: One kind of swale is a level trench on contour. It slows and spreads runoff so some water can soak into suitable soil. Other swales are designed with a slight, controlled grade to carry excess water slowly to a safe outlet. Which approach fits your land depends on the soil, slope, drainage and storm flow. Have a trained local adviser check the line, overflow and receiving point before digging.

Nḓila ine ya fanelea your land i bva kha mavu, slope, drainage na storm flow. Musi ni sa athu u bwa, humbelani trained local adviser uri a sedze line, overflow na receiving point.

Sheba metso, sebopeho sa mobu le motsamao wa metsi, hammoho le dintho tse phelang mobung tse bonahalang.

Sand e dula fatshe pele. Silt e latela, athe clay e ka nna ya dula e suspended nako e telele haholo.
Ena ke boikwetliso ba ho ithuta ba kakanyo feela. Dikgobokano tsa mobu (clumps) le clay e so duleng fatshe di ka o kgelosa; sebedisa soil laboratory ha o hloka soil texture e nepahetseng.
Lera le letenya la sand ka tlasa cloudy water ha le eso o bolelle final proportions. Fine particles tse ding di ka nna tsa dula di suspended.
Bapisa layers tse lutseng fatshe, ’me u utloe mobu tšimong.
Ngola seo u se bonang le seo u sa kholisehang ka sona. U se ke ua etsa qeto ea ho nosetsa kapa ho alafa mobu ka lebaka la nkho e le ’ngoe feela.
Ho thatafala ha mobu (compaction), drainage e mpe le tahlehelo ya organic matter di ka sitisa metso le bophelo ba mobu.
Mmala o lerootho kapa palo e nyane ya diboko ha e pake hore dikhemikhale di bolaile mobu. Mosebetsi wa diboko le wona o a fetoha ho latela mongobo le sehla.
Batla mekhoa e iphetang tšimong. Hlahloba nalane ea tsamaiso, drainage le kholo ea limela pele u khetha tharollo.

bodyBeforeParagraphs: Compost ke organic matter e broken down ka tsela e laolwang.
Compost e phethilweng e ka ntlafatsa sebopeho sa mobu mme ya fana ka dimatlafatsi.
Nako ya hore compost e lokele ho sebediswa e fapana ho ya ka dintho tse sebediswang, mongobo, moya le thempereitjha. Lebitso la profinse kapa palo e behilweng ya dibeke ha se readiness test.
Kopanya dry browns le fresh greens. Qoba layers tse teteaneng, tse metsi tse thibelang moya ho kena.
Ha qubu ya compost e ka ba slimy kapa e nkha ammonia haholo, eketsa dry browns mme o e phethole.
Hlahloba mongobo le moya ha qubu ya compost e ntse e fetoha; mokgwa o le mong wa ho kopanya ha o tshwanele motswako o mong le o mong wa dintho tse sebediswang.
Karolo e bohareng e tjhesang ya qubu ha e pake hore karolo e nngwe le e nngwe ya yona e se e treated. Nako, temperature le tsamaiso ya yona kaofela di bohlokwa.
Boloka nama, dairy, dimela tse kulang, pet waste le contaminated materials di le ka ntle ho tsamaiso ena e bonolo ya lapeng.
U se ke ua nahana hore home composting e fedisa peo e nngwe le e nngwe ya mofoka kapa disease organism e nngwe le e nngwe. Sebedisa recognised process moo sanitation e hlokahalang.
Boloka wattle seed pods di le ka ntle ho qubu ya compost. Qubu e tlwaelehileng e ka nna ya se etse hore peo e nngwe le e nngwe e be non-viable.
Sebedisa dintho tse hlwekileng feela, tse sa alafwang. Bark e bola butle; lebitso la yona feela ha le pake hore ha e na contamination.
Hlahloba qubu ya compost mme o e phethole ha e hloka moya o mongata kapa ho kopanngwa. E boloke e le mongobo, e se ke ya ba waterlogged.

bodyBeforeParagraphs: Koahela mobu o pepesitsweng ka mulch e hlwekileng e loketseng, jwalo ka straw, jwang bo ommeng kapa wood chips.
Mulch e ka fokotsa evaporation, ya fokotsa matla ao pula e otlang mobu ka ona, mme ya fokotsa kgolo ya mefoka.
E boloke e le hole le trunks and stems. Hlahloba mongobo ka tlasa mulch mme o fetole layer; mulch e ngata ha e dule e le betere.
Cover crops di ka sireletsa mobu pakeng tsa dijalo tse ka sehloohong. Di kgethe ho latela boemo ba lehodimo ba sebakeng sa heno, metsi a fumanehang le ho lema ho latelang.
Mehlala ya thuto ena e kenyelletsa oats, lupins, sunn hemp le cowpea. Hlahloba hore di loketse sebaka sa heno pele o jala.
Legumes di hloka bacteria tse loketseng le maemo a kgolo a loketseng hore di kgone ho fix nitrogen. Dimatlafatsi tse masalleng a tsona di a fumaneha ha thepa eo e ntse e bola.
Worm farms di ka fetola food scraps le bedding tse loketseng hore e be worm castings. Hlahloba setshelo ho e-na le ho lebella letsatsi le behilweng la kotulo.
Mokedikedi o itshollang ka tlhaho ho tswa ho worm bin o bitswa leachate. Ha o tshwane le worm-casting tea e lokisitsweng.
Leachate e ka ba le harmful organisms kapa dintho tse kotsi. O se ke wa e sebedisa hodima edible plants kapa wa nahana hore ho e hlapolla ho etsa hore e bolokehe.
Tšimo ea Highveld e siiloeng e sa koaheloa ka mor’a kotulo ea maize e tobana le likotsi tse peli tse kholo.
Moea oa mariha o ka nka mobu o ommeng o ka holimo.
Sefefo sa pele se matla sa selemo se ka otla mobu o sa koaheloang ’me sa senya bokaholimo le sebopeho sa mobu. Ha metsi a phalla holim’a tšimo, a ka nka mobu o khoehileng.
Dijalo tse sireletsang mobu (cover crops), mulch le organic matter di ka thusa ho tshwara mobu sebakeng sa wona le ho o thusa hore o dule o phela.

Compost yo fhelelaho i nga khwinifhadza tshivhumbeo tsha mavu, na u engedza nutrients.

Tshifhinga tsha u luga ha manyoro tshi a fhambana u ya nga zwishumiswa (materials), vhunyunyu, muya na thempheretsha (temperature). Dzina ḽa vundu kana mbalo yo vhewaho ya vhege a si tsedzuluso ya u luga ha manyoro.

Iledzani u dzhenisa wattle seed pods kha thulwi ya manyoro. Thulwi yo ḓoweleaho i nga kha ḓi sa ita uri mbeu iṅwe na iṅwe i vhe non-viable.

actualNativeLeafDeltas.sourceEnglish: Leachate is liquid that drains naturally from a worm bin. Its composition varies, so it must not be presented as a guaranteed safe feed for edible crops.

actualNativeLeafDeltas.after: Leachate ke mokelikeli o itshollang ka tlhaho ho tswa ho worm bin. Se e nang le sona se a fapana, kahoo ha ya lokela ho hlahiswa jwalo ka feed e bolokehileng ka tiisetso bakeng sa dijalo tsa dijo.

actualNativeLeafDeltas.sourceEnglish: Leachate is liquid that drains naturally from a worm bin. Its composition varies, so it must not be presented as a guaranteed safe feed for edible crops.
actualNativeLeafDeltas.before: Leachate ndi liquid i elelaho nga mvelo i tshi bva kha worm bin. Composition yayo i a fhambana, ngauralo a i tei u sumbedzwa sa feed yo khwaṱhisedzwaho uri yo tsireledzea kha edible crops.
actualNativeLeafDeltas.after: Leachate ndi liquid i elelaho nga mvelo i tshi bva kha worm bin. Zwine ya vha nazwo zwi a fhambana, ngauralo a i tei u sumbedzwa sa feed yo khwaṱhisedzwaho uri yo tsireledzea kha zwimela zwine zwa ḽiwa.

actualNativeLeafDeltas.sourceEnglish: Leachate is liquid that drains naturally from a worm bin. Its composition varies, so it must not be presented as a guaranteed safe feed for edible crops.
actualNativeLeafDeltas.before: Leachate i liquid leyi khulukaka hi ntumbuluko yi huma eka worm bin. Composition ya yona ya hambana, hikokwalaho a yi fanelanga ku kombisiwa yi ri feed leyi tiyisekisiweke leswaku yi hlayisekile eka edible crops.
actualNativeLeafDeltas.after: Leachate i liquid leyi khulukaka hi ntumbuluko yi huma eka worm bin. Swilo leswi yi nga na swona swa hambana, hikokwalaho a yi fanelanga ku kombisiwa yi ri feed leyi tiyisekisiweke leswaku yi hlayisekile eka swibyariwa leswi dyekaka.
actualNativeLeafDeltas.acceptedProposedTarget: Leachate i liquid leyi khulukaka hi ntumbuluko yi huma eka worm bin. Swilo leswi yi nga na swona swa hambana, hikokwalaho a yi fanelanga ku kombisiwa yi ri feed leyi tiyisekisiweke leswaku yi hlayisekile eka swibyariwa leswi dyekaka.

actualNativeLeafDeltas.sourceEnglish: Soil contains many kinds of living organisms. Bacteria and fungi help break down organic matter and cycle nutrients.
actualNativeLeafDeltas.before: Mobung ho na le mefuta e mengata ya dintho tse phelang. Baktheria le fungi di thusa ho break down organic matter le ho tsamaisa dimatlafatsi ka potoloho.
actualNativeLeafDeltas.after: Mobung ho na le mefuta e mengata ya dintho tse phelang. Baktheria le fungi di thusa hore organic matter e bole le ho tsamaisa dimatlafatsi ka potoloho.
actualNativeLeafDeltas.acceptedProposedTarget: Mobung ho na le mefuta e mengata ya dintho tse phelang. Baktheria le fungi di thusa hore organic matter e bole le ho tsamaisa dimatlafatsi ka potoloho.

actualNativeLeafDeltas.sourceEnglish: Compaction, poor drainage and loss of organic matter can limit roots and soil life.
actualNativeLeafDeltas.before: Compaction, poor drainage na ku lahleka ka organic matter swi nga limit timitsu ni soil life.
actualNativeLeafDeltas.after: Compaction, poor drainage na ku lahleka ka organic matter swi nga limit timitsu ni ku hanya ka misava.
actualNativeLeafDeltas.acceptedProposedTarget: Compaction, poor drainage na ku lahleka ka organic matter swi nga limit timitsu ni ku hanya ka misava.

actualNativeLeafDeltas.sourceEnglish: Time to readiness varies with materials, moisture, air and temperature. A province name or a fixed number of weeks is not a readiness test.
actualNativeLeafDeltas.before: Nako ya hore compost e lokele ho sebediswa e fapana ho ya ka dintho tse sebediswang, mongobo, moya le thempereitjha. Lebitso la profinse kapa palo e behilweng ya dibeke ha se readiness test.
actualNativeLeafDeltas.after: Nako ya hore compost e lokele ho sebediswa e fapana ho ya ka dintho tse sebediswang, mongobo, moya le thempereitjha. Lebitso la profinse kapa palo e behilweng ya dibeke ha se teko ya ho lekola hore compost e se e loketse.
actualNativeLeafDeltas.acceptedProposedTarget: Nako ya hore compost e lokele ho sebediswa e fapana ho ya ka dintho tse sebediswang, mongobo, moya le thempereitjha. Lebitso la profinse kapa palo e behilweng ya dibeke ha se teko ya ho lekola hore compost e se e loketse.

actualNativeLeafDeltas.sourceEnglish: Time to readiness varies with materials, moisture, air and temperature. A province name or a fixed number of weeks is not a readiness test.
actualNativeLeafDeltas.before: Nkarhi wo lungheka wa hambana hi swilo leswi tirhisiweke, ku tsakama, moya na temperature. Vito ra xifundzankulu kumbe nhlayo leyi vekiweke ya mavhiki a hi readiness test.

actualNativeLeafDeltas.acceptedProposedTarget: Nkarhi wo lungheka wa hambana hi swilo leswi tirhisiweke, ku tsakama, moya na temperature. Vito ra xifundzankulu kumbe nhlayo leyi vekiweke ya mavhiki a hi ndlela yo kambela leswaku compost yi lunghekile.

actualNativeLeafDeltas.sourceEnglish: Used household water can contain germs, salts, cleaning products and other substances. Guidance does not define every source in the same way. South African guidance differs on kitchen water and laundry water.

actualNativeLeafDeltas.sourceEnglish: If a reuse system is already operating and the water smells bad, pools or harms plants, stop using it and seek qualified local advice.
actualNativeLeafDeltas.before: Loko system yo tirhisa mati nakambe yi se ri karhi yi tirha naswona mati ma nunha, ma pool kumbe ma onha swimilana, tshika ku ma tirhisa kutani u lava ndzayo ya mutsundzuxi wa laha kaya loyi a nga qualified.
actualNativeLeafDeltas.after: Loko system yo tirhisa mati nakambe yi se ri karhi yi tirha naswona mati ma nunha, ma hlengeletana ma yima endhawini yin’we kumbe ma onha swimilana, tshika ku ma tirhisa kutani u lava ndzayo ya mutsundzuxi wa laha kaya loyi a nga qualified.
actualNativeLeafDeltas.acceptedProposedTarget: Loko system yo tirhisa mati nakambe yi se ri karhi yi tirha naswona mati ma nunha, ma hlengeletana ma yima endhawini yin’we kumbe ma onha swimilana, tshika ku ma tirhisa kutani u lava ndzayo ya mutsundzuxi wa laha kaya loyi a nga qualified.

actualNativeLeafDeltas.sourceEnglish: Check the source, service status, intended use and site locally before any reuse

actualNativeLeafDeltas.sourceEnglish: One kind of swale is a level trench on contour. It slows and spreads runoff so some water can soak into suitable soil. Other swales are designed with a slight, controlled grade to carry excess water slowly to a safe outlet. Which approach fits your land depends on the soil, slope, drainage and storm flow. Have a trained local adviser check the line, overflow and receiving point before digging.
