actualNativeLeafDeltas.sourceEnglish: A level contour design should spread water along its length. Uneven filling may indicate an unintended low point, but some swales are intentionally graded to a safe outlet. Check the actual design, soil and overflow route before altering it.
actualNativeLeafDeltas.before: Level contour design i tea u phaḓaladza maḓi kha vhulapfu hayo. U ḓala hu sa lingani hu nga sumbedza unintended low point, fhedzi dziṅwe swales dzi itwa nga khole dzi na grade ya u ya kha safe outlet. Ṱolani design ya vhukuma, mavu na overflow route ni sa athu u i shandula.
actualNativeLeafDeltas.after: Level contour design i tea u phaḓaladza maḓi kha vhulapfu hayo. U ḓala hu sa lingani hu nga sumbedza fhethu hu re fhasi hu songo pulaniwaho, fhedzi dziṅwe swales dzi itwa nga khole dzi na grade ya u ya kha safe outlet. Ṱolani design ya vhukuma, mavu na overflow route ni sa athu u i shandula.
actualNativeLeafDeltas.acceptedProposedTarget: Level contour design i tea u phaḓaladza maḓi kha vhulapfu hayo. U ḓala hu sa lingani hu nga sumbedza fhethu hu re fhasi hu songo pulaniwaho, fhedzi dziṅwe swales dzi itwa nga khole dzi na grade ya u ya kha safe outlet. Ṱolani design ya vhukuma, mavu na overflow route ni sa athu u i shandula.

actualNativeLeafDeltas.sourceEnglish: A farmer builds a dam wall with no spillway. After an exceptional storm it overflows. What's the likely result?
actualNativeLeafDeltas.before: Mulimi u fhaṱa dam wall i si na spillway. Nga murahu ha exceptional storm, dam i a overflow. Ndi mvelelo ifhio ine ya nga tevhela?
actualNativeLeafDeltas.after: Mulimi u fhaṱa dam wall i si na spillway. Nga murahu ha storm i songo ḓoweleaho, dam i a overflow. Ndi mvelelo ifhio ine ya nga tevhela?
actualNativeLeafDeltas.acceptedProposedTarget: Mulimi u fhaṱa dam wall i si na spillway. Nga murahu ha storm i songo ḓoweleaho, dam i a overflow. Ndi mvelelo ifhio ine ya nga tevhela?

actualNativeLeafDeltas.sourceEnglish: Farm Dams and Ponds: Storing Water for the Dry Season
actualNativeLeafDeltas.before: Madamu na Zwidziva zwa Bulasini: U Vhulunga Maḓi a Tshifhinga tsha Dry Season
actualNativeLeafDeltas.after: Madamu na Zwidziva zwa Bulasini: U Vhulunga Maḓi a Tshifhinga tsha u Oma
actualNativeLeafDeltas.acceptedProposedTarget: Madamu na Zwidziva zwa Bulasini: U Vhulunga Maḓi a Tshifhinga tsha u Oma

actualNativeLeafDeltas.sourceEnglish: Keep the tank covered, screen openings against insects, and maintain the roof, gutters and diverter. Keep rainwater separate from drinking-water pipes.
actualNativeLeafDeltas.before: Itani uri tank i dzule covered; vheani screen kha openings uri zwikhokhonono zwi si dzhene, nahone ni ṱhogomele ṱhanga, gutters na diverter. Vhulungani maḓi a mvula o fhambanywa na pipes dza maḓi a u nwa.
actualNativeLeafDeltas.after: Itani uri tank i dzule yo fukedzwaho; vheani screen kha zwikhala uri zwikhokhonono zwi si dzhene, nahone ni ṱhogomele ṱhanga, gutters na diverter. Vhulungani maḓi a mvula o fhambanywa na pipes dza maḓi a u nwa.
actualNativeLeafDeltas.acceptedProposedTarget: Itani uri tank i dzule yo fukedzwaho; vheani screen kha zwikhala uri zwikhokhonono zwi si dzhene, nahone ni ṱhogomele ṱhanga, gutters na diverter. Vhulungani maḓi a mvula o fhambanywa na pipes dza maḓi a u nwa.

actualNativeLeafDeltas.sourceEnglish: A basic filter alone is not a drinking-water guarantee. Water used on food crops also needs a safety assessment.
actualNativeLeafDeltas.before: Basic filter fhedzi a si drinking-water guarantee. Maḓi ane a shumiswa kha food crops na one a ṱoḓa safety assessment.
actualNativeLeafDeltas.after: Basic filter fhedzi a i khwaṱhisedzi uri maḓi o lugela u nwa. Maḓi ane a shumiswa kha food crops na one a ṱoḓa safety assessment.
actualNativeLeafDeltas.acceptedProposedTarget: Basic filter fhedzi a i khwaṱhisedzi uri maḓi o lugela u nwa. Maḓi ane a shumiswa kha food crops na one a ṱoḓa safety assessment.

actualNativeLeafDeltas.sourceEnglish: Plan what you will do when stored water runs low. A province name alone cannot tell you the tank size you need.
actualNativeLeafDeltas.before: Pulannani zwine na ḓo ita musi stored water runs low. Dzina ḽa vundu fhedzi a ḽi ni vhudzi vhuhulwane ha tank ine na i ṱoḓa.
actualNativeLeafDeltas.after: Pulannani zwine na ḓo ita musi maḓi o vhulungwaho a tshi sala e maṱuku. Dzina ḽa vundu fhedzi a ḽi ni vhudzi vhuhulwane ha tank ine na i ṱoḓa.
actualNativeLeafDeltas.acceptedProposedTarget: Pulannani zwine na ḓo ita musi maḓi o vhulungwaho a tshi sala e maṱuku. Dzina ḽa vundu fhedzi a ḽi ni vhudzi vhuhulwane ha tank ine na i ṱoḓa.

actualNativeLeafDeltas.sourceEnglish: Tank planning must compare usable supply with demand through wet and dry periods. One fixed regional size cannot do that.
actualNativeLeafDeltas.before: U pulana tank hu tea u vhambedza supply ine ya nga shumiswa na demand kha wet and dry periods. Sayizi nthihi ya region yo tiwaho a i nga koni u ita zwenezwo.
actualNativeLeafDeltas.after: U pulana tank hu tea u vhambedza supply ine ya nga shumiswa na demand kha zwifhinga zwa mvula na zwa u oma. Sayizi nthihi ya region yo tiwaho a i nga koni u ita zwenezwo.
actualNativeLeafDeltas.acceptedProposedTarget: U pulana tank hu tea u vhambedza supply ine ya nga shumiswa na demand kha zwifhinga zwa mvula na zwa u oma. Sayizi nthihi ya region yo tiwaho a i nga koni u ita zwenezwo.

actualNativeLeafDeltas.sourceEnglish: Rainwater Tanks and Roof Catchment: Collecting and Protecting Water
actualNativeLeafDeltas.before: Rainwater Tanks na Roof Catchment: U kuvhanganya na u tsireledza maḓi
actualNativeLeafDeltas.after: Thanngi dza maḓi a mvula na Roof Catchment: U kuvhanganya na u tsireledza maḓi
actualNativeLeafDeltas.acceptedProposedTarget: Thanngi dza maḓi a mvula na Roof Catchment: U kuvhanganya na u tsireledza maḓi

actualNativeLeafDeltas.sourceEnglish: If a reuse system is already operating and the water smells bad, pools or harms plants, stop using it and seek qualified local advice.
actualNativeLeafDeltas.before: If a reuse system is already operating and the water smells bad, pools or harms plants, litshani u a shumisa ni humbele qualified local advice.
actualNativeLeafDeltas.after: Arali system ya u shumisa maḓi hafhu yo no thoma u shuma, nahone tshiṅwe tsha izwi tsha itea: maḓi a tshi nukha zwavhi, a tshi kuvhangana fhethu huthihi, kana a tshi tshinya zwimela, litshani u a shumisa ni humbele qualified local advice.
actualNativeLeafDeltas.acceptedProposedTarget: Arali system ya u shumisa maḓi hafhu yo no thoma u shuma, nahone tshiṅwe tsha izwi tsha itea: maḓi a tshi nukha zwavhi, a tshi kuvhangana fhethu huthihi, kana a tshi tshinya zwimela, litshani u a shumisa ni humbele qualified local advice.

actualNativeLeafDeltas.sourceEnglish: Prevent contact, spray, pooling, runoff and drinking-water cross-connections
actualNativeLeafDeltas.before: Thivhelani contact, spray, pooling, runoff na drinking-water cross-connections
actualNativeLeafDeltas.after: Thivhelani u kwama, u fafadzela, maḓi a tshi ima fhethu huthihi, runoff na drinking-water cross-connections
actualNativeLeafDeltas.acceptedProposedTarget: Thivhelani u kwama, u fafadzela, maḓi a tshi ima fhethu huthihi, runoff na drinking-water cross-connections

actualNativeLeafDeltas.sourceEnglish: Why check the exact water source and cleaning products before considering reuse?
actualNativeLeafDeltas.before: Ndi ngani ri tshi fanela u ṱola exact water source na zwibveledzwa zwa u kunakisa ri sa athu humbula nga ha u shumisa maḓi hafhu?
actualNativeLeafDeltas.after: Ndi ngani ri tshi fanela u ṱola tshiko tsha maḓi tshone na zwibveledzwa zwa u kunakisa ri sa athu humbula nga ha u shumisa maḓi hafhu?
actualNativeLeafDeltas.acceptedProposedTarget: Ndi ngani ri tshi fanela u ṱola tshiko tsha maḓi tshone na zwibveledzwa zwa u kunakisa ri sa athu humbula nga ha u shumisa maḓi hafhu?

actualNativeLeafDeltas.sourceEnglish: Check the source, service status, intended use and site locally before any reuse
actualNativeLeafDeltas.before: Hlahloba mohlodi, service status, tshebediso e rerilweng le setsha sebakeng seo pele ho tshebediso efe kapa efe ya metsi hape
actualNativeLeafDeltas.after: Sebakeng sa heno, hlahloba mohlodi, service status, tshebediso e rerilweng le setsha pele ho tshebediso efe kapa efe ya metsi hape.
actualNativeLeafDeltas.acceptedProposedTarget: Sebakeng sa heno, hlahloba mohlodi, service status, tshebediso e rerilweng le setsha pele ho tshebediso efe kapa efe ya metsi hape.

actualNativeLeafDeltas.sourceEnglish: Check the source, service status, intended use and site locally before any reuse
actualNativeLeafDeltas.before: Ṱolani tshiko, service status, mushumo wo pulaniwaho na fhethu locally ni sa athu u shumisa maḓi hafhu na luthihi
actualNativeLeafDeltas.after: Kha vhupo haṋu, ṱolani tshiko, service status, mushumo wo pulaniwaho na fhethu ni sa athu u shumisa maḓi hafhu na luthihi.
actualNativeLeafDeltas.acceptedProposedTarget: Kha vhupo haṋu, ṱolani tshiko, service status, mushumo wo pulaniwaho na fhethu ni sa athu u shumisa maḓi hafhu na luthihi.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: Soil contains many kinds of living organisms. Bacteria and fungi help break down organic matter and cycle nutrients.
paragraphs.before: Mobung ho na le mefuta e mengata ya dintho tse phelang. Baktheria le fungi di thusa ho break down organic matter le ho tsamaisa dimatlafatsi ka potoloho.
paragraphs.after: Mobung ho na le mefuta e mengata ya dintho tse phelang. Baktheria le fungi di thusa hore organic matter e bole le ho tsamaisa dimatlafatsi ka potoloho.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: Some fungi help roots take up nutrients. Worm channels can help water and air enter soil.
paragraphs.before: Fungi tse ding di thusa metso ho monya dimatlafatsi. Meselana e entsweng ke diboko e ka thusa metsi le moya ho kena mobung.
paragraphs.after: Fungi tse ding di thusa metso ho monya dimatlafatsi. Meselana e entsweng ke diboko e ka thusa metsi le moya ho kena mobung.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: Look at roots, soil structure and water movement as well as visible soil life.
paragraphs.before: Sheba metso, sebopeho sa mobu le motsamao wa metsi, hammoho le dintho tse phelang mobung tse bonahalang.
paragraphs.after: Sheba metso, sebopeho sa mobu le motsamao wa metsi, hammoho le dintho tse phelang mobung tse bonahalang.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: Put soil and water in a clear jar, with a little suitable dispersing detergent. Close and shake it, then leave it undisturbed.
paragraphs.before: Kenya mobu le metsi ka jar e bonaletsang, o kenye hanyenyane ya suitable dispersing detergent. E kwale mme o e sisinye, ebe o e siya e sa sisinyehe.
paragraphs.after: Kenya mobu le metsi ka jar e bonaletsang, o kenye hanyenyane ya suitable dispersing detergent. E kwale mme o e sisinye, ebe o e siya e sa sisinyehe.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: Sand settles first. Silt settles next, while clay can remain suspended much longer.
paragraphs.before: Sand e dula fatshe pele. Silt e latela, athe clay e ka nna ya dula e suspended nako e telele haholo.
paragraphs.after: Sand e dula fatshe pele. Silt e latela, athe clay e ka nna ya dula e suspended nako e telele haholo.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: This is a rough learning exercise. Clumps and unsettled clay can mislead you; use a soil laboratory when accurate texture is needed.
paragraphs.before: Ena ke boikwetliso ba ho ithuta ba kakanyo feela. Dikgobokano tsa mobu (clumps) le clay e so duleng fatshe di ka o kgelosa; sebedisa soil laboratory ha o hloka soil texture e nepahetseng.
paragraphs.after: Ena ke boikwetliso ba ho ithuta ba kakanyo feela. Dikgobokano tsa mobu (clumps) le clay e so duleng fatshe di ka o kgelosa; sebedisa soil laboratory ha o hloka soil texture e nepahetseng.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: A thick sand layer beneath cloudy water does not yet tell you the final proportions. Some fine particles may still be suspended.
paragraphs.before: Lera le letenya la sand ka tlasa cloudy water ha le eso o bolelle final proportions. Fine particles tse ding di ka nna tsa dula di suspended.
paragraphs.after: Lera le letenya la sand ka tlasa cloudy water ha le eso o bolelle final proportions. Fine particles tse ding di ka nna tsa dula di suspended.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: Compare the settled layers and feel the soil in the field.
paragraphs.before: Bapisa layers tse lutseng fatshe, ’me u utloe mobu tšimong.
paragraphs.after: Bapisa layers tse lutseng fatshe, ’me u utloe mobu tšimong.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: Record what you see and what remains uncertain. Do not prescribe watering or soil treatments from one jar alone.
paragraphs.before: Ngola seo u se bonang le seo u sa kholisehang ka sona. U se ke ua etsa qeto ea ho nosetsa kapa ho alafa mobu ka lebaka la nkho e le ’ngoe feela.
paragraphs.after: Ngola seo u se bonang le seo u sa kholisehang ka sona. U se ke ua etsa qeto ea ho nosetsa kapa ho alafa mobu ka lebaka la nkho e le ’ngoe feela.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: Compaction, poor drainage and loss of organic matter can limit roots and soil life.
paragraphs.before: Ho thatafala ha mobu (compaction), drainage e mpe le tahlehelo ya organic matter di ka sitisa metso le bophelo ba mobu.
paragraphs.after: Ho thatafala ha mobu (compaction), drainage e mpe le tahlehelo ya organic matter di ka sitisa metso le bophelo ba mobu.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: Pale colour or few worms do not prove that chemicals killed the soil. Worm activity also changes with moisture and season.
paragraphs.before: Mmala o lerootho kapa palo e nyane ya diboko ha e pake hore dikhemikhale di bolaile mobu. Mosebetsi wa diboko le wona o a fetoha ho latela mongobo le sehla.
paragraphs.after: Mmala o lerootho kapa palo e nyane ya diboko ha e pake hore dikhemikhale di bolaile mobu. Mosebetsi wa diboko le wona o a fetoha ho latela mongobo le sehla.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: Look for patterns across the field. Check management history, drainage and plant growth before choosing a remedy.
paragraphs.before: Batla mekhoa e iphetang tšimong. Hlahloba nalane ea tsamaiso, drainage le kholo ea limela pele u khetha tharollo.
paragraphs.after: Batla mekhoa e iphetang tšimong. Hlahloba nalane ea tsamaiso, drainage le kholo ea limela pele u khetha tharollo.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: Compost is organic matter broken down under managed conditions.
paragraphs.before: Compost ke organic matter e broken down ka tsela e laolwang.
paragraphs.after: Compost ke organic matter e broken down ka tsela e laolwang.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: Finished compost can improve soil structure and contribute nutrients.
paragraphs.before: Compost e phethilweng e ka ntlafatsa sebopeho sa mobu mme ya fana ka dimatlafatsi.
paragraphs.after: Compost e phethilweng e ka ntlafatsa sebopeho sa mobu mme ya fana ka dimatlafatsi.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: Time to readiness varies with materials, moisture, air and temperature. A province name or a fixed number of weeks is not a readiness test.
paragraphs.before: Nako ya hore compost e lokele ho sebediswa e fapana ho ya ka dintho tse sebediswang, mongobo, moya le thempereitjha. Lebitso la profinse kapa palo e behilweng ya dibeke ha se readiness test.
paragraphs.after: Nako ya hore compost e lokele ho sebediswa e fapana ho ya ka dintho tse sebediswang, mongobo, moya le thempereitjha. Lebitso la profinse kapa palo e behilweng ya dibeke ha se teko ya ho lekola hore compost e se e loketse.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: Mix dry browns with fresh greens. Avoid thick, wet layers that keep air out.
paragraphs.before: Kopanya dry browns le fresh greens. Qoba layers tse teteaneng, tse metsi tse thibelang moya ho kena.
paragraphs.after: Kopanya dry browns le fresh greens. Qoba layers tse teteaneng, tse metsi tse thibelang moya ho kena.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: If the heap becomes slimy or smells strongly of ammonia, add dry browns and turn it.
paragraphs.before: Ha qubu ya compost e ka ba slimy kapa e nkha ammonia haholo, eketsa dry browns mme o e phethole.
paragraphs.after: Ha qubu ya compost e ka ba slimy kapa e nkha ammonia haholo, eketsa dry browns mme o e phethole.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: Check moisture and air as the heap changes; one recipe does not suit every mix of materials.
paragraphs.before: Hlahloba mongobo le moya ha qubu ya compost e ntse e fetoha; mokgwa o le mong wa ho kopanya ha o tshwanele motswako o mong le o mong wa dintho tse sebediswang.
paragraphs.after: Hlahloba mongobo le moya ha qubu ya compost e ntse e fetoha; mokgwa o le mong wa ho kopanya ha o tshwanele motswako o mong le o mong wa dintho tse sebediswang.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: A hot centre does not prove that every part of a heap has been treated. Time, temperature and management all matter.
paragraphs.before: Karolo e bohareng e tjhesang ya qubu ha e pake hore karolo e nngwe le e nngwe ya yona e se e treated. Nako, temperature le tsamaiso ya yona kaofela di bohlokwa.
paragraphs.after: Karolo e bohareng e tjhesang ya qubu ha e pake hore karolo e nngwe le e nngwe ya yona e se e treated. Nako, temperature le tsamaiso ya yona kaofela di bohlokwa.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: Keep meat, dairy, diseased plants, pet waste and contaminated materials out of this simple household system.
paragraphs.before: Boloka nama, dairy, dimela tse kulang, pet waste le contaminated materials di le ka ntle ho tsamaiso ena e bonolo ya lapeng.
paragraphs.after: Boloka nama, dihlahiswa tsa maswi, dimela tse kulang, pet waste le contaminated materials di le ka ntle ho tsamaiso ena e bonolo ya lapeng.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: Do not assume home composting destroys every weed seed or disease organism. Use a recognised process where sanitation is required.
paragraphs.before: U se ke ua nahana hore home composting e fedisa peo e nngwe le e nngwe ya mofoka kapa disease organism e nngwe le e nngwe. Sebedisa recognised process moo sanitation e hlokahalang.
paragraphs.after: U se ke ua nahana hore home composting e fedisa peo e nngwe le e nngwe ya mofoka kapa disease organism e nngwe le e nngwe. Sebedisa recognised process moo sanitation e hlokahalang.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: Keep wattle seed pods out of the compost heap. An ordinary heap may not make every seed non-viable.
paragraphs.before: Boloka wattle seed pods di le ka ntle ho qubu ya compost. Qubu e tlwaelehileng e ka nna ya se etse hore peo e nngwe le e nngwe e be non-viable.
paragraphs.after: Boloka wattle seed pods di le ka ntle ho qubu ya compost. Qubu e tlwaelehileng e ka nna ya se etse hore peo e nngwe le e nngwe e be non-viable.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: Use only clean, untreated materials. Bark breaks down slowly; its name alone is not proof that it is free of contamination.
paragraphs.before: Sebedisa dintho tse hlwekileng feela, tse sa alafwang. Bark e bola butle; lebitso la yona feela ha le pake hore ha e na contamination.
paragraphs.after: Sebedisa clean, untreated materials feela. Bark e bola butle; lebitso la yona feela ha le pake hore ha e na contamination.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: Check the heap and turn when it needs more air or mixing. Keep it moist rather than waterlogged.
paragraphs.before: Hlahloba qubu ya compost mme o e phethole ha e hloka moya o mongata kapa ho kopanngwa. E boloke e le mongobo, e se ke ya ba waterlogged.
paragraphs.after: Hlahloba qubu ya compost mme o e phethole ha e hloka moya o mongata kapa ho kopanngwa. E boloke e le mongobo, e se ke ya ba waterlogged.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: Cover bare soil with suitable clean mulch, such as straw, dry grass or wood chips.
paragraphs.before: Koahela mobu o pepesitsweng ka mulch e hlwekileng e loketseng, jwalo ka straw, jwang bo ommeng kapa wood chips.
paragraphs.after: Koahela mobu o pepesitsweng ka mulch e hlwekileng e loketseng, jwalo ka straw, jwang bo ommeng kapa wood chips.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: Mulch can reduce evaporation, soften the impact of rain and suppress weeds.
paragraphs.before: Mulch e ka fokotsa evaporation, ya fokotsa matla ao pula e otlang mobu ka ona, mme ya fokotsa kgolo ya mefoka.
paragraphs.after: Mulch e ka fokotsa evaporation, ya fokotsa matla ao pula e otlang mobu ka ona, mme ya fokotsa kgolo ya mefoka.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: Keep it clear of trunks and stems. Check moisture underneath and adjust the layer; more mulch is not always better.
paragraphs.before: E boloke e le hole le trunks and stems. Hlahloba mongobo ka tlasa mulch mme o fetole layer; mulch e ngata ha e dule e le betere.
paragraphs.after: E boloke e le hole le trunks and stems. Hlahloba mongobo ka tlasa mulch mme o fetole layer; mulch e ngata ha e dule e le betere.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: Cover crops can protect ground between main crops. Choose for local weather, available water and the next planting.
paragraphs.before: Cover crops di ka sireletsa mobu pakeng tsa dijalo tse ka sehloohong. Di kgethe ho latela boemo ba lehodimo ba sebakeng sa heno, metsi a fumanehang le ho lema ho latelang.
paragraphs.after: Cover crops di ka sireletsa mobu pakeng tsa dijalo tse ka sehloohong. Di kgethe ho latela boemo ba lehodimo ba sebakeng sa heno, metsi a fumanehang le ho lema ho latelang.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: The course examples include oats, lupins, sunn hemp and cowpea. Check local suitability before sowing.
paragraphs.before: Mehlala ya thuto ena e kenyelletsa oats, lupins, sunn hemp le cowpea. Hlahloba hore di loketse sebaka sa heno pele o jala.
paragraphs.after: Mehlala ya thuto ena e kenyelletsa oats, lupins, sunn hemp le cowpea. Hlahloba hore di loketse sebaka sa heno pele o jala.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: Legumes need suitable bacteria and growing conditions to fix nitrogen. Nutrients in their residues become available as the material decomposes.
paragraphs.before: Legumes di hloka bacteria tse loketseng le maemo a kgolo a loketseng hore di kgone ho fix nitrogen. Dimatlafatsi tse masalleng a tsona di a fumaneha ha thepa eo e ntse e bola.
paragraphs.after: Legumes di hloka bacteria tse loketseng le maemo a kgolo a loketseng hore di kgone ho fix nitrogen. Dimatlafatsi tse masalleng a tsona di a fumaneha ha thepa eo e ntse e bola.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: Worm farms can turn suitable food scraps and bedding into castings. Check the bin rather than expecting a fixed harvest date.
paragraphs.before: Worm farms di ka fetola food scraps le bedding tse loketseng hore e be worm castings. Hlahloba setshelo ho e-na le ho lebella letsatsi le behilweng la kotulo.
paragraphs.after: Worm farms di ka fetola food scraps le bedding tse loketseng hore e be worm castings. Hlahloba setshelo ho e-na le ho lebella letsatsi le behilweng la kotulo.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: Liquid that drains naturally from a worm bin is called leachate. It is not the same as a prepared worm-casting tea.
paragraphs.before: Mokedikedi o itshollang ka tlhaho ho tswa ho worm bin o bitswa leachate. Ha o tshwane le worm-casting tea e lokisitsweng.
paragraphs.after: Mokedikedi o itshollang ka tlhaho ho tswa ho worm bin o bitswa leachate. Ha o tshwane le worm-casting tea e lokisitsweng.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: Leachate can contain harmful organisms or substances. Do not use it on edible plants or assume that dilution makes it safe.
paragraphs.before: Leachate e ka ba le harmful organisms kapa dintho tse kotsi. O se ke wa e sebedisa hodima edible plants kapa wa nahana hore ho e hlapolla ho etsa hore e bolokehe.
paragraphs.after: Leachate e ka ba le harmful organisms kapa dintho tse kotsi. O se ke wa e sebedisa dimeleng tse ka jewang kapa wa nahana hore ho e hlapolla ho etsa hore e bolokehe.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: A Highveld field left bare after the maize harvest faces two main risks.
paragraphs.before: Tšimo ea Highveld e siiloeng e sa koaheloa ka mor’a kotulo ea maize e tobana le likotsi tse peli tse kholo.
paragraphs.after: Tšimo ea Highveld e siiloeng e sa koaheloa ka mor’a kotulo ea maize e tobana le likotsi tse peli tse kholo.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: Winter wind can carry away dry topsoil.
paragraphs.before: Moea oa mariha o ka nka mobu o ommeng o ka holimo.
paragraphs.after: Moea oa mariha o ka nka mobu o ommeng o ka holimo.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: The first heavy spring storm can strike bare ground and damage its surface and structure. If water runs over the field, it can carry loosened soil away.
paragraphs.before: Sefefo sa pele se matla sa selemo se ka otla mobu o sa koaheloang ’me sa senya bokaholimo le sebopeho sa mobu. Ha metsi a phalla holim’a tšimo, a ka nka mobu o khoehileng.
paragraphs.after: Sefefo sa pele se matla sa selemo se ka otla mobu o sa koaheloang ’me sa senya bokaholimo le sebopeho sa mobu. Ha metsi a phalla holim’a tšimo, a ka nka mobu o khoehileng.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: Cover crops, mulch, and organic matter can help hold soil in place and help it stay alive.
paragraphs.before: Dijalo tse sireletsang mobu (cover crops), mulch le organic matter di ka thusa ho tshwara mobu sebakeng sa wona le ho o thusa hore o dule o phela.
paragraphs.after: Dijalo tse sireletsang mobu (cover crops), mulch le organic matter di ka thusa ho tshwara mobu sebakeng sa wona le ho o thusa hore o dule o phela.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: Compost is organic matter broken down under managed conditions.
paragraphs.before: Compost ndi organic matter yo broken down nga fhasi ha zwiimo zwi langulwaho.
paragraphs.after: Compost ndi organic matter yo broken down nga fhasi ha zwiimo zwi langulwaho.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: Finished compost can improve soil structure and contribute nutrients.
paragraphs.before: Compost yo fhelelaho i nga khwinifhadza tshivhumbeo tsha mavu, na u engedza nutrients.
paragraphs.after: Compost yo fhelelaho i nga khwinifhadza tshivhumbeo tsha mavu, na u engedza nutrients.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: Time to readiness varies with materials, moisture, air and temperature. A province name or a fixed number of weeks is not a readiness test.
paragraphs.before: Tshifhinga tsha u luga ha manyoro tshi a fhambana u ya nga zwishumiswa (materials), vhunyunyu, muya na thempheretsha (temperature). Dzina ḽa vundu kana mbalo yo vhewaho ya vhege a si tsedzuluso ya u luga ha manyoro.
paragraphs.after: Tshifhinga tsha u luga ha manyoro tshi a fhambana u ya nga zwishumiswa (materials), vhunyunyu, muya na thempheretsha (temperature). Dzina ḽa vundu kana mbalo yo vhewaho ya vhege a si tsedzuluso ya u luga ha manyoro.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: Mix dry browns with fresh greens. Avoid thick, wet layers that keep air out.
paragraphs.before: Tanganyani dry browns na fresh greens. Iledzani thick, wet layers dzi thivhelaho muya u dzhena.
paragraphs.after: Tanganyani dry browns na fresh greens. Iledzani thick, wet layers dzi thivhelaho muya u dzhena.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: If the heap becomes slimy or smells strongly of ammonia, add dry browns and turn it.
paragraphs.before: Arali thulwi ya manyoro ya vha slimy kana ya nukha ammonia nga maanḓa, shelani dry browns nahone ni i rembuluse.
paragraphs.after: Arali thulwi ya manyoro ya vha slimy kana ya nukha ammonia nga maanḓa, shelani dry browns nahone ni i rembuluse.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: Check moisture and air as the heap changes; one recipe does not suit every mix of materials.
paragraphs.before: Sedzulusani vhunyunyu na muya musi thulwi i tshi khou shanduka; nḓila nthihi ya u ṱanganya a i lulameli muṱanganyo muṅwe na muṅwe wa zwishumiswa.
paragraphs.after: Sedzulusani vhunyunyu na muya musi thulwi i tshi khou shanduka; nḓila nthihi ya u ṱanganya a i lulameli muṱanganyo muṅwe na muṅwe wa zwishumiswa.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: A hot centre does not prove that every part of a heap has been treated. Time, temperature and management all matter.
paragraphs.before: Vhukati ho fhisaho a vhu khwaṱhisedzi uri tshipida tshiṅwe na tshiṅwe tsha thulwi tsho treated. Tshifhinga, temperature na ndangulo zwoṱhe zwi na ndeme.
paragraphs.after: Vhukati ho fhisaho a vhu khwaṱhisedzi uri tshipida tshiṅwe na tshiṅwe tsha thulwi tsho treated. Tshifhinga, temperature na ndangulo zwoṱhe zwi na ndeme.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: Keep meat, dairy, diseased plants, pet waste and contaminated materials out of this simple household system.
paragraphs.before: Iledzani u dzhenisa nyama, dairy, zwimela zwi re na malwadze, pet waste na contaminated materials kha iyi nḓila i leluwaho ya muṱani.
paragraphs.after: Iledzani u dzhenisa nyama, zwibveledzwa zwa mafhi, zwimela zwi re na malwadze, pet waste na contaminated materials kha iyi nḓila i leluwaho ya muṱani.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: Do not assume home composting destroys every weed seed or disease organism. Use a recognised process where sanitation is required.
paragraphs.before: Ni songo humbula uri home composting i fhedza weed seed iṅwe na iṅwe kana disease organism iṅwe na iṅwe. Shumisani recognised process hune sanitation ya ṱoḓea.
paragraphs.after: Ni songo humbula uri home composting i fhedza weed seed iṅwe na iṅwe kana disease organism iṅwe na iṅwe. Shumisani recognised process hune sanitation ya ṱoḓea.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: Keep wattle seed pods out of the compost heap. An ordinary heap may not make every seed non-viable.
paragraphs.before: Iledzani u dzhenisa wattle seed pods kha thulwi ya manyoro. Thulwi yo ḓoweleaho i nga kha ḓi sa ita uri mbeu iṅwe na iṅwe i vhe non-viable.
paragraphs.after: Iledzani u dzhenisa wattle seed pods kha thulwi ya manyoro. Thulwi yo ḓoweleaho i nga kha ḓi sa ita uri mbeu iṅwe na iṅwe i vhe non-viable.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: Use only clean, untreated materials. Bark breaks down slowly; its name alone is not proof that it is free of contamination.
paragraphs.before: Shumisani zwishumiswa zwo kunaho, zwi songo treated fhedzi. Bark i a sina nga u ongowa; dzina layo fhedzi a si vhuṱanzi ha uri a i na contamination.
paragraphs.after: Shumisani fhedzi clean, untreated materials. Bark i a sina nga u ongowa; dzina layo fhedzi a si vhuṱanzi ha uri a i na contamination.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: Check the heap and turn when it needs more air or mixing. Keep it moist rather than waterlogged.
paragraphs.before: Sedzulusani thulwi ni i rembuluse musi i tshi toda muya wo engedzeaho kana u tanganiswa. I vhulungeni i na vhunyunyu, hu si waterlogged.
paragraphs.after: Sedzulusani thulwi ni i rembuluse musi i tshi toda muya wo engedzeaho kana u tanganiswa. I vhulungeni i na vhunyunyu, hu si waterlogged.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: Cover bare soil with suitable clean mulch, such as straw, dry grass or wood chips.
paragraphs.before: Fukedzani mavu a songo fukwaho nga mulch yo kunaho, yo teaho, u fana na straw, hatsi ho omaho kana wood chips.
paragraphs.after: Fukedzani mavu a songo fukwaho nga mulch yo kunaho, yo teaho, u fana na straw, hatsi ho omaho kana wood chips.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: Mulch can reduce evaporation, soften the impact of rain and suppress weeds.
paragraphs.before: Mulch i nga fhungudza evaporation; i nga fhungudza u rwa ha mvula; i nga thivhela weeds.
paragraphs.after: Mulch i nga fhungudza evaporation; i nga fhungudza u rwa ha mvula; i nga thivhela weeds.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: Keep it clear of trunks and stems. Check moisture underneath and adjust the layer; more mulch is not always better.
paragraphs.before: I vhetseni kule na trunks and stems. Sedzani vhunyunyu nga fhasi hayo ni lulamise layer; mulch nnzhi a i dzuli i tshi vha yavhuḓi.
paragraphs.after: I vhetseni kule na trunks and stems. Sedzani vhunyunyu nga fhasi hayo ni lulamise layer; mulch nnzhi a i dzuli i tshi vha yavhuḓi.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: Cover crops can protect ground between main crops. Choose for local weather, available water and the next planting.
paragraphs.before: Cover crops dzi nga tsireledza mavu vhukati ha main crops. Khethani u ya nga mutsho wa henefho, maḓi ane a vha hone na u zwala hu tevhelaho.
paragraphs.after: Cover crops dzi nga tsireledza mavu vhukati ha main crops. Khethani u ya nga mutsho wa henefho, maḓi ane a vha hone na u zwala hu tevhelaho.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: The course examples include oats, lupins, sunn hemp and cowpea. Check local suitability before sowing.
paragraphs.before: Tsumbo dza ngudo dzi katela oats, lupins, sunn hemp na cowpea. Sedzani arali dzi tshi fanela fhethu haṋu ni sa athu dzi zwala.
paragraphs.after: Tsumbo dza ngudo dzi katela oats, lupins, sunn hemp na cowpea. Sedzani arali dzi tshi fanela fhethu haṋu ni sa athu dzi zwala.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: Legumes need suitable bacteria and growing conditions to fix nitrogen. Nutrients in their residues become available as the material decomposes.
paragraphs.before: Legumes dzi ṱoḓa bacteria dzo teaho na zwiimo zwo teaho zwa u mela u fix nitrogen. Nutrients dzi re kha masalela adzo dzi a wanala musi material i tshi decompose.
paragraphs.after: Legumes dzi ṱoḓa bacteria dzo teaho na zwiimo zwo teaho zwa u mela u fix nitrogen. Nutrients dzi re kha masalela adzo dzi a wanala musi material i tshi decompose.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: Worm farms can turn suitable food scraps and bedding into castings. Check the bin rather than expecting a fixed harvest date.
paragraphs.before: Worm farms dzi nga shandula food scraps na bedding zwo teaho zwa vha castings. Sedzani tshifaredzi, ni songo lavhelela ḓuvha ḽo vhewaho ḽa u kaṋa.
paragraphs.after: Worm farms dzi nga shandula food scraps na bedding zwo teaho zwa vha castings. Sedzani tshifaredzi, ni songo lavhelela ḓuvha ḽo vhewaho ḽa u kaṋa.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: Liquid that drains naturally from a worm bin is called leachate. It is not the same as a prepared worm-casting tea.
paragraphs.before: Liquid i elelaho nga mvelo i tshi bva kha worm bin i vhidzwa leachate. A si tshithu tshithihi na worm-casting tea yo lugiswaho.
paragraphs.after: Liquid i elelaho nga mvelo i tshi bva kha worm bin i vhidzwa leachate. A si tshithu tshithihi na worm-casting tea yo lugiswaho.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: Leachate can contain harmful organisms or substances. Do not use it on edible plants or assume that dilution makes it safe.
paragraphs.before: Leachate i nga vha na harmful organisms kana zwithu zwi re na khombo. Ni songo i shumisa kha edible plants kana u humbula uri dilution i ita uri i vhe yo tsireledzeaho.
paragraphs.after: Leachate i nga vha na harmful organisms kana zwithu zwi re na khombo. Ni songo i shumisa kha zwimela zwine zwa nga ḽiwa kana u humbula uri dilution i ita uri i vhe yo tsireledzeaho.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: A Highveld field left bare after the maize harvest faces two main risks.
paragraphs.before: Tsimu ya Highveld yo salaho i songo fukedzwa nga murahu ha u kaṋa maize i sedzana na khombo mbili khulwane.
paragraphs.after: Tsimu ya Highveld yo salaho i songo fukedzwa nga murahu ha u kaṋa maize i sedzana na khombo mbili khulwane.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: Winter wind can carry away dry topsoil.
paragraphs.before: Mhepo ya vhuria i nga hwala topsoil yo omaho ya i bvisa.
paragraphs.after: Mhepo ya vhuria i nga hwala topsoil yo omaho ya i bvisa.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: The first heavy spring storm can strike bare ground and damage its surface and structure. If water runs over the field, it can carry loosened soil away.
paragraphs.before: Storm ya u thoma khulwane ya spring i nga rwa mavu a songo fukedzwaho, ya tshinyadza surface na structure ya hone. Arali maḓi a tshi elela nṱha ha tsimu, a nga hwala loosened soil a a bvisa.
paragraphs.after: Storm ya u thoma khulwane ya spring i nga rwa mavu a songo fukedzwaho, ya tshinyadza surface na structure ya hone. Arali maḓi a tshi elela nṱha ha tsimu, a nga hwala loosened soil a a bvisa.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: Cover crops, mulch, and organic matter can help hold soil in place and help it stay alive.
paragraphs.before: Cover crops, mulch na organic matter zwi nga thusa u fara mavu fhethu hayo na u thusa uri a dzule a tshi khou tshila.
paragraphs.after: Cover crops, mulch na organic matter zwi nga thusa u fara mavu fhethu hayo na u thusa uri a dzule a tshi khou tshila.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: Soil contains many kinds of living organisms. Bacteria and fungi help break down organic matter and cycle nutrients.
paragraphs.before: Misava yi na tinxaka to tala ta swilo leswi hanyaka. Bacteria na fungi swi pfuna ku break down organic matter ni ku cycle nutrients.
paragraphs.after: Misava yi na tinxaka to tala ta swilo leswi hanyaka. Bacteria na fungi swi pfuna ku endla leswaku organic matter yi bola ni ku endla leswaku nutrients ti famba hi xirhendzevutana.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: Some fungi help roots take up nutrients. Worm channels can help water and air enter soil.
paragraphs.before: Fungi tin'wana ti pfuna timitsu ku tswonga nutrients. Worm channels ti nga pfuna mati na moya ku nghena emhlabeni.
paragraphs.after: Fungi tin'wana ti pfuna timitsu ku tswonga nutrients. Worm channels ti nga pfuna mati na moya ku nghena emhlabeni.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: Look at roots, soil structure and water movement as well as visible soil life.
paragraphs.before: Languta timitsu, xivumbeko xa misava ni ndlela leyi mati ma fambaka ha yona, swin’we ni leswi hanyaka emisaveni leswi u swi vonaka.
paragraphs.after: Languta timitsu, xivumbeko xa misava ni ndlela leyi mati ma fambaka ha yona, swin’we ni leswi hanyaka emisaveni leswi u swi vonaka.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: Put soil and water in a clear jar, with a little suitable dispersing detergent. Close and shake it, then leave it undisturbed.
paragraphs.before: Chela misava na mati eka jar leyi u vonaka leswi nga endzeni ka yona, u chela nyana suitable dispersing detergent. Pfala jar u yi ninginika, kutani u yi tshika yi nga ninginiki.
paragraphs.after: Chela misava na mati eka jar leyi u vonaka leswi nga endzeni ka yona, u chela nyana suitable dispersing detergent. Pfala jar u yi ninginika, kutani u yi tshika yi nga ninginiki.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: Sand settles first. Silt settles next, while clay can remain suspended much longer.
paragraphs.before: Sand yi sungula ku tshamisa ehansi. Silt yi tshamisa endzhaku ka yona, kasi clay yi nga ha sala yi suspended nkarhi wo leha swinene.
paragraphs.after: Sand yi sungula ku tshamisa ehansi. Silt yi tshamisa endzhaku ka yona, kasi clay yi nga ha sala yi suspended nkarhi wo leha swinene.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: This is a rough learning exercise. Clumps and unsettled clay can mislead you; use a soil laboratory when accurate texture is needed.
paragraphs.before: Lowu i ntoloveto wo dyondza wo ringanyeta. Clumps na clay leyi nga si tshamaka ehansi swi nga ku hambukisa; tirhisa soil laboratory loko ku laveka soil texture leyi pimiweke kahle.
paragraphs.after: Lowu i ntoloveto wo dyondza wo ringanyeta. Clumps na clay leyi nga si tshamaka ehansi swi nga ku hambukisa; tirhisa soil laboratory loko ku laveka soil texture leyi pimiweke kahle.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: A thick sand layer beneath cloudy water does not yet tell you the final proportions. Some fine particles may still be suspended.
paragraphs.before: Thick sand layer ehansi ka cloudy water a yi si komba final proportions. Fine particles tin’wana ti nga ha va suspended.
paragraphs.after: Thick sand layer ehansi ka cloudy water a yi si komba final proportions. Fine particles tin’wana ti nga ha va suspended.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: Compare the settled layers and feel the soil in the field.
paragraphs.before: Fananisa settled layers, kutani u twa misava ensin'wini.
paragraphs.after: Fananisa settled layers, kutani u twa misava ensin'wini.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: Record what you see and what remains uncertain. Do not prescribe watering or soil treatments from one jar alone.
paragraphs.before: Tsala leswi u swi vonaka ni leswi nga si tiyiseka. U nga teki xiboho xa ku cheleta kumbe ku tirhisa ndlela yo lulamisa misava hi ku ya hi jar yin’we ntsena.
paragraphs.after: Tsala leswi u swi vonaka ni leswi nga si tiyiseka. U nga teki xiboho xa ku cheleta kumbe ku tirhisa ndlela yo lulamisa misava hi ku ya hi jar yin’we ntsena.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: Compaction, poor drainage and loss of organic matter can limit roots and soil life.
paragraphs.before: Compaction, poor drainage na ku lahleka ka organic matter swi nga limit timitsu ni soil life.
paragraphs.after: Compaction, poor drainage na ku lahleka ka organic matter swi nga limit timitsu ni ku hanya ka misava.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: Pale colour or few worms do not prove that chemicals killed the soil. Worm activity also changes with moisture and season.
paragraphs.before: Muhlovo lowu nga vonakaka wa pale kumbe worms ti nga ri tingani a swi tiyisisi leswaku chemicals ti dlayile misava. Worm activity na yona ya cinca hi ku ya hi ku tsakama na nguva.
paragraphs.after: Muhlovo lowu nga vonakaka wa pale kumbe worms ti nga ri tingani a swi tiyisisi leswaku chemicals ti dlayile misava. Worm activity na yona ya cinca hi ku ya hi ku tsakama na nguva.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: Look for patterns across the field. Check management history, drainage and plant growth before choosing a remedy.
paragraphs.before: Languta patterns leti humelelaka ensin'wini hinkwaro. Kambela matimu ya malawulelo, drainage ni ku kula ka swimilani u nga si hlawula ndlela yo lulamisa.
paragraphs.after: Languta patterns leti humelelaka ensin'wini hinkwaro. Kambela matimu ya malawulelo, drainage ni ku kula ka swimilani u nga si hlawula ndlela yo lulamisa.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: Compost is organic matter broken down under managed conditions.
paragraphs.before: Compost i organic matter leyi broken down ehansi ka swiyimo leswi lawuriwaka.
paragraphs.after: Compost i organic matter leyi broken down ehansi ka swiyimo leswi lawuriwaka.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: Finished compost can improve soil structure and contribute nutrients.
paragraphs.before: Compost leyi lunghekeke yi nga antswisa xivumbeko xa misava ni ku engetela nutrients.
paragraphs.after: Compost leyi lunghekeke yi nga antswisa xivumbeko xa misava ni ku engetela nutrients.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: Time to readiness varies with materials, moisture, air and temperature. A province name or a fixed number of weeks is not a readiness test.
paragraphs.before: Nkarhi wo lungheka wa hambana hi swilo leswi tirhisiweke, ku tsakama, moya na temperature. Vito ra xifundzankulu kumbe nhlayo leyi vekiweke ya mavhiki a hi readiness test.
paragraphs.after: Nkarhi wo lungheka wa hambana hi swilo leswi tirhisiweke, ku tsakama, moya na temperature. Vito ra xifundzankulu kumbe nhlayo leyi vekiweke ya mavhiki a hi ndlela yo kambela leswaku compost yi lunghekile.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: Mix dry browns with fresh greens. Avoid thick, wet layers that keep air out.
paragraphs.before: Hlanganisa dry browns na fresh greens. Papalata thick layers leti tsakamaka leti sivelaka moya ku nghena.
paragraphs.after: Hlanganisa dry browns na fresh greens. Papalata thick layers leti tsakamaka leti sivelaka moya ku nghena.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: If the heap becomes slimy or smells strongly of ammonia, add dry browns and turn it.
paragraphs.before: Loko nhulu yi va slimy kumbe yi nun'hwa ammonia swinene, engetela dry browns kutani u yi hundzuluxa.
paragraphs.after: Loko nhulu yi va slimy kumbe yi nun'hwa ammonia swinene, engetela dry browns kutani u yi hundzuluxa.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: Check moisture and air as the heap changes; one recipe does not suit every mix of materials.
paragraphs.before: Kambela ku tsakama na moya loko nhulu yi ri karhi yi cinca; ndlela yin'we yo hlanganisa a yi ringani eka nkatsakanyo wun'wana ni wun'wana wa swilo leswi tirhisiweke.
paragraphs.after: Kambela ku tsakama na moya loko nhulu yi ri karhi yi cinca; ndlela yin'we yo hlanganisa a yi ringani eka nkatsakanyo wun'wana ni wun'wana wa swilo leswi tirhisiweke.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: A hot centre does not prove that every part of a heap has been treated. Time, temperature and management all matter.
paragraphs.before: Xiphemu xa le xikarhini xa nhulu lexi hisaka a xi tiyisisi leswaku xiphemu xin’wana ni xin’wana xa nhulu xi treated. Nkarhi, temperature ni ndlela yo yi lawula hinkwato swi na nkoka.
paragraphs.after: Xiphemu xa le xikarhini xa nhulu lexi hisaka a xi tiyisisi leswaku xiphemu xin’wana ni xin’wana xa nhulu xi treated. Nkarhi, temperature ni ndlela yo yi lawula hinkwato swi na nkoka.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: Keep meat, dairy, diseased plants, pet waste and contaminated materials out of this simple household system.
paragraphs.before: Hlayisani nyama, dairy, swimilani leswi vabyaka, pet waste na contaminated materials swi ri ehandle ka ndlela leyi olovaka ya ndyangu.
paragraphs.after: Hlayisani nyama, dairy, swimilani leswi vabyaka, pet waste na contaminated materials swi ri ehandle ka ndlela leyi olovaka ya ndyangu.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: Do not assume home composting destroys every weed seed or disease organism. Use a recognised process where sanitation is required.
paragraphs.before: U nga teki leswaku home composting yi lovisa weed seed yin'wana ni yin'wana kumbe disease organism yin'wana ni yin'wana. Tirhisa recognised process laha sanitation yi lavekaka.
paragraphs.after: U nga teki leswaku home composting yi lovisa weed seed yin'wana ni yin'wana kumbe disease organism yin'wana ni yin'wana. Tirhisa recognised process laha sanitation yi lavekaka.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: Keep wattle seed pods out of the compost heap. An ordinary heap may not make every seed non-viable.
paragraphs.before: Hlayisani wattle seed pods ehandle ka nhulu ya compost. Nhulu leyi tolovelekeke yi nga ha ka yi nga endli mbewu yin’wana ni yin’wana yi va non-viable.
paragraphs.after: Hlayisani wattle seed pods ehandle ka nhulu ya compost. Nhulu leyi tolovelekeke yi nga ha ka yi nga endli mbewu yin’wana ni yin’wana yi va non-viable.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: Use only clean, untreated materials. Bark breaks down slowly; its name alone is not proof that it is free of contamination.
paragraphs.before: Tirhisa swilo leswi baseke, leswi untreated ntsena. Bark yi bola hi ku nonoka; vito ra yona ntsena a hi vumbhoni bya leswaku a yi na contamination.
paragraphs.after: Tirhisa swilo leswi baseke, leswi untreated ntsena. Bark yi bola hi ku nonoka; vito ra yona ntsena a hi vumbhoni bya leswaku a yi na contamination.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: Check the heap and turn when it needs more air or mixing. Keep it moist rather than waterlogged.
paragraphs.before: Kambela nhulu kutani u yi hundzuluxa loko yi lava moya wo tala kumbe ku hlanganisiwa. Yi hlayise yi tsakamile, ku nga ri waterlogged.
paragraphs.after: Kambela nhulu kutani u yi hundzuluxa loko yi lava moya wo tala kumbe ku hlanganisiwa. Yi hlayise yi tsakamile, ku nga ri waterlogged.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: Cover bare soil with suitable clean mulch, such as straw, dry grass or wood chips.
paragraphs.before: Funengetani misava leyi nga funengetiwangiki hi mulch leyi basekile, leyi faneleke, yo fana na straw, byanyi byo oma kumbe wood chips.
paragraphs.after: Funengetani misava leyi nga funengetiwangiki hi mulch leyi basekile, leyi faneleke, yo fana na straw, byanyi byo oma kumbe wood chips.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: Mulch can reduce evaporation, soften the impact of rain and suppress weeds.
paragraphs.before: Mulch yi nga hunguta evaporation; yi nga olovisa ku ba ka mpfula naswona yi nga sivela nhova.
paragraphs.after: Mulch yi nga hunguta evaporation; yi nga olovisa ku ba ka mpfula naswona yi nga sivela nhova.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: Keep it clear of trunks and stems. Check moisture underneath and adjust the layer; more mulch is not always better.
paragraphs.before: Yi hlayiseni ekule na trunks and stems. Kambelani ku tsakama ehansi ka yona, mi lulamisa layer; mulch yo tala a yi vuli leswaku swi ta antswa nkarhi wun'wana ni wun'wana.
paragraphs.after: Yi hlayiseni ekule na trunks and stems. Kambelani ku tsakama ehansi ka yona, mi lulamisa layer; mulch yo tala a yi vuli leswaku swi ta antswa nkarhi wun'wana ni wun'wana.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: Cover crops can protect ground between main crops. Choose for local weather, available water and the next planting.
paragraphs.before: Cover crops ti nga sirhelela misava leyi nga kona exikari ka main crops. Ti hlawuleni hi ku ya hi maxelo ya laha, mati lama kumekaka ni ku byala loku landzelaka.
paragraphs.after: Cover crops ti nga sirhelela misava leyi nga kona exikari ka main crops. Ti hlawuleni hi ku ya hi maxelo ya laha, mati lama kumekaka ni ku byala loku landzelaka.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: The course examples include oats, lupins, sunn hemp and cowpea. Check local suitability before sowing.
paragraphs.before: Swikombiso swa dyondzo swi katsa oats, lupins, sunn hemp na cowpea. Kambelani loko swi fanele ndhawu ya kwalaho mi nga si swi byala.
paragraphs.after: Swikombiso swa dyondzo swi katsa oats, lupins, sunn hemp na cowpea. Kambelani loko swi fanele ndhawu ya kwalaho mi nga si swi byala.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: Legumes need suitable bacteria and growing conditions to fix nitrogen. Nutrients in their residues become available as the material decomposes.
paragraphs.before: Legumes ti lava bacteria leti faneleke ni swiyimo leswi faneleke swa ku kula leswaku ti fix nitrogen. Nutrients leti nga eka masalela ya tona ta kumeka loko material yi ri karhi yi bola.
paragraphs.after: Legumes ti lava bacteria leti faneleke ni swiyimo leswi faneleke swa ku kula leswaku ti fix nitrogen. Nutrients leti nga eka masalela ya tona ta kumeka loko material yi ri karhi yi bola.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: Worm farms can turn suitable food scraps and bedding into castings. Check the bin rather than expecting a fixed harvest date.
paragraphs.before: Worm farms ti nga hundzuluxa food scraps ni bedding leswi faneleke swi va castings. Kambelani xibye ematshan'weni yo langutela siku ra ntshovelo leri vekiweke.
paragraphs.after: Worm farms ti nga hundzuluxa food scraps ni bedding leswi faneleke swi va castings. Kambelani xibye ematshan'weni yo langutela siku ra ntshovelo leri vekiweke.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: Liquid that drains naturally from a worm bin is called leachate. It is not the same as a prepared worm-casting tea.
paragraphs.before: Liquid leyi khulukaka hi ntumbuluko yi huma eka worm bin yi vuriwa leachate. A yi fani na worm-casting tea leyi lunghisiweke.
paragraphs.after: Liquid leyi khulukaka hi ntumbuluko yi huma eka worm bin yi vuriwa leachate. A yi fani na worm-casting tea leyi lunghisiweke.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: Leachate can contain harmful organisms or substances. Do not use it on edible plants or assume that dilution makes it safe.
paragraphs.before: Leachate yi nga va na harmful organisms kumbe substances leswi nga ni khombo. U nga yi tirhisi eka edible plants. U nga ehleketi leswaku dilution yi endla leswaku yi hlayiseka.
paragraphs.after: Leachate yi nga va na harmful organisms kumbe swilo leswi nga ni khombo. U nga yi tirhisi eka swimilani leswi dyiwaka. U nga ehleketi leswaku dilution yi endla leswaku yi hlayiseka.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: A Highveld field left bare after the maize harvest faces two main risks.
paragraphs.before: Nsimu ya Highveld leyi tshikiweke yi nga funengetiwangi endzhaku ka ntshovelo wa maize yi langutana ni makhombo mambirhi lamakulu.
paragraphs.after: Nsimu ya Highveld leyi tshikiweke yi nga funengetiwangi endzhaku ka ntshovelo wa maize yi langutana ni makhombo mambirhi lamakulu.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: Winter wind can carry away dry topsoil.
paragraphs.before: Mheho wa xixika wu nga susa misava ya le henhla leyi omeke.
paragraphs.after: Mheho wa xixika wu nga susa misava ya le henhla leyi omeke.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: The first heavy spring storm can strike bare ground and damage its surface and structure. If water runs over the field, it can carry loosened soil away.
paragraphs.before: Xidzedze xo sungula xo tika xa ximun’wana xi nga hlasela misava leyi nga funengetiwangi, xi onha vuandlalo ni xivumbeko xa yona. Loko mati ma khuluka ehenhla ka nsimu, ma nga teka misava leyi ntshunxekeke ma famba na yona.
paragraphs.after: Xidzedze xo sungula xo tika xa ximun’wana xi nga hlasela misava leyi nga funengetiwangi, xi onha vuandlalo ni xivumbeko xa yona. Loko mati ma khuluka ehenhla ka nsimu, ma nga teka misava leyi ntshunxekeke ma famba na yona.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: Cover crops, mulch, and organic matter can help hold soil in place and help it stay alive.
paragraphs.before: Swibyariwa swo sirhelela misava (cover crops), mulch ni organic matter swi nga pfuna ku khoma misava endhawini ya yona ni ku yi pfuna leswaku yi ya mahlweni yi hanya.
paragraphs.after: Swibyariwa swo sirhelela misava (cover crops), mulch ni organic matter swi nga pfuna ku khoma misava endhawini ya yona ni ku yi pfuna leswaku yi ya mahlweni yi hanya.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: One kind of swale is a level trench on contour. It slows and spreads runoff so some water can soak into suitable soil. Other swales are designed with a slight, controlled grade to carry excess water slowly to a safe outlet. Which approach fits your land depends on the soil, slope, drainage and storm flow. Have a trained local adviser check the line, overflow and receiving point before digging.
paragraphs.before: Lushaka luthihi lwa swale ndi level trench on contour. I fhungudza luvhilo na u phaḓaladza runoff, uri maḓi maṅwe a kone u dzhena kha mavu o teaho. Dziṅwe swales dzi itelwa u vha na slight, controlled grade uri dzi hwale maḓi o engedzeaho nga u ongologa a tshi ya kha safe outlet. Nḓila ine ya fanelea your land i bva kha mavu, slope, drainage na storm flow. Musi ni sa athu u bwa, humbelani trained local adviser uri a sedze line, overflow na receiving point.
paragraphs.after: Lushaka luthihi lwa swale ndi level trench on contour. I fhungudza luvhilo na u phaḓaladza runoff, uri maḓi maṅwe a kone u dzhena kha mavu o teaho. Dziṅwe swales dzi itelwa u vha na slight, controlled grade uri dzi hwale maḓi o engedzeaho nga u ongologa a tshi ya kha safe outlet. Nḓila ine ya fanelea land yaṋu i bva kha mavu, slope, drainage na storm flow. Musi ni sa athu u bwa, humbelani trained local adviser uri a sedze line, overflow na receiving point.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: The excavated soil forms a berm on the downhill side, where trees can be planted when the site design is suitable.
paragraphs.before: Mavu o bwiwaho a vhumba berm nga thungo ya downhill, hune miri ya nga ṱavhiwa arali site design yo tea.
paragraphs.after: Mavu o bwiwaho a vhumba berm nga thungo ya downhill, hune miri ya nga ṱavhiwa arali site design yo tea.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: Trees planted there may draw on moisture stored in the soil after rain, depending on the site.
paragraphs.before: Miri yo ṱavhiwaho henefho i nga shumisa moisture yo vhulungwaho mavuni nga murahu ha mvula, zwi tshi ya nga site.
paragraphs.after: Miri yo ṱavhiwaho henefho i nga shumisa moisture yo vhulungwaho mavuni nga murahu ha mvula, zwi tshi ya nga fhethu.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: Heavy rain can fill a swale faster than water soaks into the soil. Plan a safe overflow before digging.
paragraphs.before: Mvula khulwane i nga ḓadza swale nga luvhilo lu fhiraho lune maḓi a dzhena ngalwo mavuni. Pulani safe overflow ni sa athu u bwa.
paragraphs.after: Mvula khulwane i nga ḓadza swale nga luvhilo lu fhiraho lune maḓi a dzhena ngalwo mavuni. Pulani safe overflow ni sa athu u bwa.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: The route must not erode the slope or send damaging water to a neighbour. A downstream swale or dam must be able to receive it safely.
paragraphs.before: Nḓila a i tei u erode slope kana u rumela maḓi a tshinyaho kha muhura. A downstream swale or dam must be able to receive it safely.
paragraphs.after: Nḓila a i tei u erode slope kana u rumela maḓi a tshinyaho kha muhura. Swale ya downstream kana damu ḽa downstream ḽi fanela u kona u ṱanganedza maḓi ayo safely.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: Ask a trained local adviser to assess the soil, slope and storm flow. A picture is not a construction design.
paragraphs.before: Humbelani trained local adviser uri a ṱole mavu, slope na storm flow. Tshifanyiso a si construction design.
paragraphs.after: Humbelani trained local adviser uri a ṱole mavu, slope na storm flow. Tshifanyiso a si construction design.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: Slope alone does not tell you whether a swale is suitable. Soil, drainage, unstable ground and the water arriving from upslope all matter.
paragraphs.before: Slope fhedzi a i sumbedzi arali swale yo tea. Mavu, drainage, unstable ground na maḓi ane a bva upslope zwoṱhe zwi na ndeme.
paragraphs.after: Slope fhedzi a i sumbedzi arali swale yo tea. Mavu, drainage, unstable ground na maḓi ane a bva upslope zwoṱhe zwi na ndeme.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: Keep good ground cover. Get a local assessment before digging on steep, wet or unstable land. Grass barriers and terraces also need a design suited to the site.
paragraphs.before: Vhulungani ground cover yavhuḓi. Wanani local assessment ni sa athu u bwa kha steep, wet kana unstable land. Grass barriers na terraces na zwone zwi ṱoḓa design yo teaho site.
paragraphs.after: Vhulungani ground cover yavhuḓi. Wanani local assessment ni sa athu u bwa kha steep, wet kana unstable land. Grass barriers na terraces na zwone zwi ṱoḓa design yo teaho site.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: Your roof can collect rainwater. The amount depends on roof area, rainfall and losses.
paragraphs.before: Ṱhanga ya ṋu i nga kuvhanganya madi a mvula. Madi ane a wanala a bva kha vhuhulwane ha ṱhanga, mvula na madi a xelaho.
paragraphs.after: Ṱhanga ya ṋu i nga kuvhanganya madi a mvula. Madi ane a wanala a bva kha vhuhulwane ha ṱhanga, mvula na madi a xelaho.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: Check whether the roof material is suitable for rainwater collection before connecting a tank.
paragraphs.before: Ṱolani arali roof material yo tea u kuvhanganya maḓi a mvula musi ni sa athu u ṱumanya tank.
paragraphs.after: Ṱolani arali roof material yo tea u kuvhanganya maḓi a mvula musi ni sa athu u ṱumanya tank.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: Use the roof area seen from above and local rainfall records. Then allow for water that misses the gutter, is diverted or overflows a full tank.
paragraphs.before: Shumisani vhuhulwane ha ṱhanga vhune ha vhonala u bva nṱha na rekhodo dza mvula dza henefho. Nga murahu ni dzhiele nṱha maḓi ane a si dzhene kha gutter, ane a diverted kana ane a overflow kha tank yo ḓalaho.
paragraphs.after: Shumisani vhuhulwane ha ṱhanga vhune ha vhonala u bva nṱha na rekhodo dza mvula dza henefho. Nga murahu ni dzhiele nṱha maḓi ane a si dzhene kha gutter, ane a diverted kana ane a overflow kha tank yo ḓalaho.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: An annual total does not tell you how much water will be available during a dry spell. Compare supply with the uses you plan.
paragraphs.before: Tshivhalo tsha ṅwaha woṱhe a tshi ni vhudzi uri hu ḓo vha na maḓi mangana kha dry spell. Vhambedzani supply na mishumo ine na pulana u shumisa maḓi hayo.
paragraphs.after: Tshivhalo tsha ṅwaha woṱhe a tshi ni vhudzi uri hu ḓo vha na maḓi mangana kha dry spell. Vhambedzani supply na mishumo ine na pulana u shumisa maḓi hayo.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: Roof runoff can carry dust, droppings and other contamination. A first-flush diverter keeps some of the first runoff out of the tank.
paragraphs.before: Runoff ya ṱhanga i nga hwala buse, droppings na iṅwe contamination. First-flush diverter i thivhela maṅwe maḓi a runoff ya u thoma uri a si dzhene kha tank.
paragraphs.after: Runoff ya ṱhanga i nga hwala buse, droppings na iṅwe contamination. First-flush diverter i thivhela maṅwe maḓi a runoff ya u thoma uri a si dzhene kha tank.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: The required diversion depends on the roof and system. Use the supplier's sizing and maintenance instructions; there is no single volume for every roof.
paragraphs.before: Diversion ine ya ṱoḓea i ḓitika nga ṱhanga na system. Shumisani ndaela dza supplier dza sizing na maintenance; a hu na volume nthihi ine ya shuma kha ṱhanga iṅwe na iṅwe.
paragraphs.after: Diversion ine ya ṱoḓea i ḓitika nga ṱhanga na system. Shumisani ndaela dza supplier dza sizing na maintenance; a hu na volume nthihi ine ya shuma kha ṱhanga iṅwe na iṅwe.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: A diverter does not make the remaining water safe to drink.
paragraphs.before: Diverter a i iti uri maḓi o salaho a vhe o tsireledzea u nwiwa.
paragraphs.after: Diverter a i iti uri maḓi o salaho a vhe o tsireledzea u nwiwa.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: Tank size depends on water demand, rain, roof area and the length of dry periods.
paragraphs.before: Vhuhulwane ha tank vhu bva kha water demand, mvula, vhuhulwane ha ṱhanga na vhulapfu ha dry periods.
paragraphs.after: Vhuhulwane ha tank vhu bva kha water demand, mvula, vhuhulwane ha ṱhanga na vhulapfu ha dry periods.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: List the intended uses and estimate their demand from your own records. Compare that with supply through the seasons.
paragraphs.before: Ṅwalani mishumo yo pulaniwaho nahone ni anganyele demand yayo ni tshi shumisa rekhodo dzaṋu. Vhambedzani demand yayo na supply u mona na zwifhinga zwa ṅwaha.
paragraphs.after: Ṅwalani mishumo yo pulaniwaho nahone ni anganyele demand yayo ni tshi shumisa rekhodo dzaṋu. Vhambedzani demand yayo na supply u mona na zwifhinga zwa ṅwaha.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: Plan what you will do when stored water runs low. A province name alone cannot tell you the tank size you need.
paragraphs.before: Pulannani zwine na ḓo ita musi stored water runs low. Dzina ḽa vundu fhedzi a ḽi ni vhudzi vhuhulwane ha tank ine na i ṱoḓa.
paragraphs.after: Pulannani zwine na ḓo ita musi maḓi o vhulungwaho a tshi sala e maṱuku. Dzina ḽa vundu fhedzi a ḽi ni vhudzi vhuhulwane ha tank ine na i ṱoḓa.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: Keep the tank covered, screen openings against insects, and maintain the roof, gutters and diverter. Keep rainwater separate from drinking-water pipes.
paragraphs.before: Itani uri tank i dzule covered; vheani screen kha openings uri zwikhokhonono zwi si dzhene, nahone ni ṱhogomele ṱhanga, gutters na diverter. Vhulungani maḓi a mvula o fhambanywa na pipes dza maḓi a u nwa.
paragraphs.after: Itani uri tank i dzule yo fukedzwaho; vheani screen kha zwikhala uri zwikhokhonono zwi si dzhene, nahone ni ṱhogomele ṱhanga, gutters na diverter. Vhulungani maḓi a mvula o fhambanywa na pipes dza maḓi a u nwa.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: Water that looks clear may still contain germs or chemicals. Ask the local health authority about testing and treatment suited to the intended use.
paragraphs.before: Maḓi ane a vhonala o kuna a nga kha ḓi vha na germs kana chemicals. Vhudzisani local health authority nga testing na treatment zwo teaho mushumo wo pulaniwaho.
paragraphs.after: Maḓi ane a vhonala o kuna a nga kha ḓi vha na germs kana chemicals. Vhudzisani local health authority nga testing na treatment zwo teaho mushumo wo pulaniwaho.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: A basic filter alone is not a drinking-water guarantee. Water used on food crops also needs a safety assessment.
paragraphs.before: Basic filter fhedzi a si drinking-water guarantee. Maḓi ane a shumiswa kha food crops na one a ṱoḓa safety assessment.
paragraphs.after: Basic filter fhedzi a i khwaṱhisedzi uri maḓi o lugela u nwa. Maḓi ane a shumiswa kha food crops na one a ṱoḓa safety assessment.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: Used household water can contain germs, salts, cleaning products and other substances. Guidance does not define every source in the same way. South African guidance differs on kitchen water and laundry water.
paragraphs.before: Maḓi o shumiswaho hayani a nga vha na germs, salts, zwibveledzwa zwa u kunakisa na zwiṅwe zwithu. Tsivhudzo a i ṱalusi tshiko tshiṅwe na tshiṅwe nga nḓila nthihi. Tsivhudzo ya Afurika Tshipembe i fhambana nga ha maḓi a khishini na maḓi a u ṱanzwa zwiambaro.
paragraphs.after: Maḓi o shumiswaho hayani a nga vha na germs, salts, zwibveledzwa zwa u kunakisa na zwiṅwe zwithu. Tsivhudzo a i ṱalusi tshiko tshiṅwe na tshiṅwe nga nḓila nthihi. Tsivhudzo ya Afurika Tshipembe i fhambana nga ha maḓi a khishini na maḓi a u ṱanzwa zwiambaro.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: Do not include toilet water, water from nappies, washing a sick person or washing animals in a reuse plan. Do not reuse water containing harmful chemicals.
paragraphs.before: Ni songo katela maḓi a toilet, maḓi a bvaho kha nappies, maḓi a u ṱanzwa muthu a lwalaho kana a u ṱanzwa zwipuka kha pulane ya u shumisa maḓi hafhu. Ni songo dovha na shumisa maḓi a re na chemicals dzi vhaisaho.
paragraphs.after: Ni songo katela maḓi a toilet, maḓi a bvaho kha nappies, maḓi a u ṱanzwa muthu a lwalaho kana a u ṱanzwa zwipuka kha pulane ya u shumisa maḓi hafhu. Ni songo dovha na shumisa maḓi a re na chemicals dzi vhaisaho.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: Before any reuse, ask the municipality and a qualified local sanitation adviser to check the exact source, the household's water and sanitation services, the intended use and the site. If this advice is unavailable or unclear, do not reuse the water.
paragraphs.before: Ni sa athu u shumisa maḓi hafhu na luthihi, humbelani masipala na qualified local sanitation adviser uri vha ṱole exact source, tshumelo dza maḓi na sanitation dza muṱa, mushumo wo pulaniwaho na fhethu. Arali nyeletshedzo iyi i siho kana i sa pfali, ni songo shumisa maḓi hafhu.
paragraphs.after: Ni sa athu u shumisa maḓi hafhu na luthihi, humbelani masipala na qualified local sanitation adviser uri vha ṱole exact source, tshumelo dza maḓi na sanitation dza muṱa, mushumo wo pulaniwaho na fhethu. Arali nyeletshedzo iyi i siho kana i sa pfali, ni songo shumisa maḓi hafhu.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: A generic picture is not a farm design. Soil and mulch do not disinfect wastewater. Keep it away from drinking-water plumbing and prevent contact with people or animals. Do not spray it, let it pool, or allow it to run off the property into a street, drain or watercourse.
paragraphs.before: Tshifanyiso tshi angaredzaho a si farm design. Mavu na mulch a zwi disinfect wastewater. Vheani wastewater kule na drinking-water plumbing nahone ni thivhele uri i kwame vhathu kana zwipuka. Ni songo i fafadzela, ni songo i tendela i tshi pool, nahone ni songo i tendela i tshi elela i tshi bva kha property i tshi ya tshiṱaraṱani, kha drain kana watercourse.
paragraphs.after: Tshifanyiso tshi angaredzaho a si farm design. Mavu na mulch a zwi disinfect wastewater. Vheani wastewater kule na drinking-water plumbing nahone ni thivhele uri i kwame vhathu kana zwipuka. Ni songo i fafadzela, ni songo i tendela i tshi pool, nahone ni songo i tendela i tshi elela i tshi bva kha property i tshi ya tshiṱaraṱani, kha drain kana watercourse.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: If a reuse system is already operating and the water smells bad, pools or harms plants, stop using it and seek qualified local advice.
paragraphs.before: If a reuse system is already operating and the water smells bad, pools or harms plants, litshani u a shumisa ni humbele qualified local advice.
paragraphs.after: Arali system ya u shumisa maḓi hafhu yo no thoma u shuma, nahone tshiṅwe tsha izwi tsha itea: maḓi a tshi nukha zwavhi, a tshi kuvhangana fhethu huthihi, kana a tshi tshinya zwimela, litshani u a shumisa ni humbele qualified local advice.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: Used household water can contain germs, salts, cleaning products and other substances. Guidance does not define every source in the same way. South African guidance differs on kitchen water and laundry water.
paragraphs.before: Mati lama tirhisiweke ekaya ma nga va na germs, salts, cleaning products ni swilo swin’wana. Swiletelo a swi hlamuseli swihlovo hinkwato hi ndlela yin’we. Swiletelo swa Afrika-Dzonga swi hambana hi mati ya le khixini ni mati yo hlantswa swiambalo.
paragraphs.after: Mati lama tirhisiweke ekaya ma nga va na germs, salts, swibveledzwa swo basisa ni swilo swin’wana. Swiletelo a swi hlamuseli swihlovo hinkwato hi ndlela yin’we. Swiletelo swa Afrika-Dzonga swi hambana hi mati ya le khixini ni mati yo hlantswa swiambalo.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: Do not include toilet water, water from nappies, washing a sick person or washing animals in a reuse plan. Do not reuse water containing harmful chemicals.
paragraphs.before: U nga katsi mati ya xihambukelo, mati yo huma eka nappies, mati yo hlantswa munhu loyi a vabyaka kumbe mati yo hlantswa swiharhi eka pulani yo tirhisa mati nakambe. U nga tirhisi nakambe mati lama nga na chemicals leti nga ni khombo.
paragraphs.after: U nga katsi mati ya xihambukelo, mati yo huma eka nappies, mati yo hlantswa munhu loyi a vabyaka kumbe mati yo hlantswa swiharhi eka pulani yo tirhisa mati nakambe. U nga tirhisi nakambe mati lama nga na chemicals leti nga ni khombo.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: Before any reuse, ask the municipality and a qualified local sanitation adviser to check the exact source, the household's water and sanitation services, the intended use and the site. If this advice is unavailable or unclear, do not reuse the water.
paragraphs.before: Before any reuse, kombela masipala na mutsundzuxi wa sanitation wa laha kaya loyi a nga qualified ku kambela xihlovo xa mati lexi kongomeke, vukorhokeri bya mati na sanitation bya ndyangu, ku tirhisiwa loku kunguhatiweke na ndhawu. Loko ndzayo leyi yi nga kumeki kumbe yi nga ri erivaleni, u nga ma tirhisi nakambe.
paragraphs.after: Before any reuse, kombela masipala na mutsundzuxi wa sanitation wa laha kaya loyi a nga qualified ku kambela xihlovo xa mati lexi kongomeke, vukorhokeri bya mati na sanitation bya ndyangu, ku tirhisiwa loku kunguhatiweke na ndhawu. Loko ndzayo leyi yi nga kumeki kumbe yi nga ri erivaleni, u nga ma tirhisi nakambe.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: A generic picture is not a farm design. Soil and mulch do not disinfect wastewater. Keep it away from drinking-water plumbing and prevent contact with people or animals. Do not spray it, let it pool, or allow it to run off the property into a street, drain or watercourse.
paragraphs.before: Xifaniso xo angarhela a hi pulani ya purasi. Misava ni mulch a swi disinfect wastewater. Hlayisa wastewater yi ri ekule ni plumbing ya mati yo nwa naswona u sivela leswaku yi khumba vanhu kumbe swiharhi. U nga ma fafazeli, u nga ma tshiki ma pool, naswona u nga ma pfumeleli ku khuluka ma huma eka property ma nghena exitarateni, eka drain kumbe eka watercourse.
paragraphs.after: Xifaniso xo angarhela a hi pulani ya purasi. Misava ni mulch a swi disinfect wastewater. Hlayisa wastewater yi ri ekule ni plumbing ya mati yo nwa naswona u sivela leswaku yi khumba vanhu kumbe swiharhi. U nga ma fafazeli, u nga ma tshiki ma pool, naswona u nga ma pfumeleli ku khuluka ma huma eka property ma nghena exitarateni, eka drain kumbe eka watercourse.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: If a reuse system is already operating and the water smells bad, pools or harms plants, stop using it and seek qualified local advice.
paragraphs.before: Loko system yo tirhisa mati nakambe yi se ri karhi yi tirha naswona mati ma nunha, ma pool kumbe ma onha swimilana, tshika ku ma tirhisa kutani u lava ndzayo ya mutsundzuxi wa laha kaya loyi a nga qualified.
paragraphs.after: Loko system yo tirhisa mati nakambe yi se ri karhi yi tirha naswona mati ma nunha, ma hlengeletana ma yima endhawini yin’we kumbe ma onha swimilana, tshika ku ma tirhisa kutani u lava ndzayo ya mutsundzuxi wa laha kaya loyi a nga qualified.
